items.source: Set this to false when using a StopWatch for millions of tasks; otherwise, the TaskInfo structure will consume excessive memory.
items.translation: 将此设置为false，在使用StopWatch处理数百万个任务时；否则，TaskInfo结构将消耗大量内存。

items.source: Conceals use of System.nanoTime(), improving the readability of application code and reducing the likelihood of calculation errors.
items.translation: 隐藏对 `System.nanoTime()` 的使用，提高了应用程序代码的可读性并降低了计算错误的概率。

items.source: Running time is tracked and reported in nanoseconds. As of Spring Framework 6.1, the default time unit for String renderings is seconds with decimal points in nanosecond precision. Custom renderings with specific time units can be requested through prettyPrint(TimeUnit).
items.translation: 运行时间以纳秒为单位进行跟踪和报告。自 Spring Framework 6.1 起，字符串渲染的默认时间单位为秒，并带有纳秒精度的小数点。可以通过 prettyPrint(TimeUnit) 请求具有特定时间单位的自定义渲染。

items.source: The results are undefined if timing methods are called without invoking at least one pair of start() / stop() methods.
items.translation: 如果未调用至少一对 `start()` / `stop()` 方法就调用计时方法，则结果未定义。

items.source:
Note that this object is not designed to be thread-safe and does not use
synchronization.
items.translation: 注意，此对象并非设计为线程安全，且不使用同步机制。

items.source:
This class is normally used to verify performance during proof-of-concept
work and in development, rather than as part of production applications.
items.translation: 该类通常用于概念验证工作和开发期间的性能验证，而不是作为生产应用程序的一部分。
